findings.current: I felt hot blood run down my forehead.
findings.defect: The assembled text omits the distinct sensation of stinging pain.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly says he felt an aching, stinging pain before noting the blood running down his forehead.
findings.replacement: A sharp, stinging pain. I felt hot blood run down my forehead.

findings.current: Until Baeksang’s eyes, flashing with killing intent, turned toward me.
findings.defect: The narration omits that the speaker remained motionless and simply watched Baeksang.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly describes the speaker not moving and only watching before Baeksang’s gaze turns toward him.
findings.replacement: But I didn’t move. I just watched him until Baeksang’s eyes, flashing with killing intent, turned toward me.

summary: Mostly faithful, with one idiom mistranslated and two physical details omitted.
